title: ㅢ의 세 가지 소리: 의사, 회의, 나의
objective: Read words with ㅢ and choose the right sound, [의], [이], or [에].
summary: Learn when ㅢ sounds like [의], [이], or [에].

task.title: Read and sound out ㅢ
task.line: Check where ㅢ appears and what it means, then choose or write its sound.

words.exampleMeaning: These are the papers for the meeting. (회의 [회의/회이])
My day (a common diary title; 나의 [나의/나에])

letters.letter: 의 inside a word, not the first syllable (not the 's / of 의)
letters.as: Can also be said as 'ee': 회의 [회의/회이].

exercises: Write the only correct sound: ① 의미 ② 희다
Write both allowed sounds, separated by /: ① 거의 ② 너의 ③ 아이의
Is the sound in [ ] allowed? Answer Yes or No: ① 의사 [이사] ② 주의 [주이] ③ 우리의 [우리에]
Write the everyday sound of each phrase, using [이] or [에] wherever allowed: ① 우리의 의사 ② 나무의 무늬
answers: ① No (only [의사]) ② Yes ([주의] is also correct) ③ Yes ([우리의] is also correct)
① [우리에 의사] (also correct: [우리의 의사]) ② [나무에 무니] (also correct: [나무의 무니])
